description: Likert batteries, done like a research agency. Diverging stacked bars with the neutral split on the axis, N/A answers detached, top and bottom box nets, means on the scale - and, for insights teams, significance letters between segments on weighted effective bases. Map Question, Answer (scale) and a Value; that is the whole setup. Free forever - and never blocked The best unweighted likert rendering on the shelf: neutral handling (auto-centred, custom position or none), reverse scale, a collapsed disagree / neutral / agree view, N/A detached with in / out-of-base choice, % labels with a minimum-size threshold, sorting by top box, legend, bases (n=), means, margins of error, an All statements row. Tracker mode: add a Wave field and the bars show the latest wave with the change of every top box since the previous one. Dimensions and benchmarks: a Group field turns the battery into sections with pooled score bars; a Benchmark measure shows the delta against your norm on every statement; a Question Text field carries the full wording into tooltips. Says the finding: a smart caption with the highest and lowest statement, the strongest dimension and what beats the norm - offline, in your language, read out by screen readers; an agency footnote with base, weighted and effective n and source; Quick Styles (Agency deck, Executive summary, Compact tracker). Every cosmetic option: 4…
